# 2 Baruch Chapter 16 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** First Fast and Vision

---

**16:1** "For-this-world is-to-those-who-live-in-it a-struggle and-a-great-weariness; and-the-coming-[world] is-a-crown for-those-who-dwell-in-it, with-righteousness-and-all-honor-and-glory. For-for-this-reason [this-world] has-been-made-to-be-temporary, as-a-passage-for-it."

---

*EMET notes: Ch.16 is a single-verse summary that bridges the Two-Ages theology of ch.15 with the Adam-sin discussion of ch.17. "Passage" = this world is transitional, not ultimate. The brevity is structural — a hinge verse.*
